source: Transit axis. The base rule is COMPUTED in build.py (not stored here): transit is 'free' wherever the entry type is visa-free or freedom-of-movement, because airside transit is strictly less privileged than entry — if you can enter a country without a visa, you can always remain in its international transit area. Every other corridor defaults to 'unknown'.
note: Two curated, cited forms. 'policies' is a uniform rule (one transit value + note) applied to the cross product of a passport set and a destination set -- e.g. the Schengen airport-transit-visa nationality list -- and only fills corridors the base rule left 'unknown' (it never overrides a visa-free-entry 'free'). 'overrides' is explicit per-corridor rules, the most specific form. 'required' = a transit visa is needed even for an airside connection (the high-value safety case); 'free' = no transit visa is needed despite a non-visa-free entry requirement. Each entry carries source_page + source_url. The UK (DATV), US (C-1/VWP) and China (TWOV) hubs are deferred (see 'deferred').

policies.name: schengen_atv_core
policies.note: Airport transit visa (ATV) required to transit airside through any Schengen airport (or Cyprus), even without leaving the international transit area (EU common list, Visa Code Reg. 810/2009). Not required if you hold a valid EU/EEA/CA/JP/US visa or residence permit.

policies.name: uk_datv
policies.default_note: Direct Airside Transit visa (DATV) required to transit airside through the UK -- airside transit is available only at London Heathrow and Manchester -- when you need a visa to enter and are not on the exempt list.
policies.exempt_note: No DATV needed for these nationalities (airside transit at LHR/MAN). Taiwan: non-PIN passports only; Venezuela: biometric passports only. Also exempt if you hold a valid AU/CA/NZ/US visa or an EEA/UK residence permit.
policies.source_page: Visa policy of the United Kingdom

deferred: United Kingdom (GB): Direct Airside Transit Visa (DATV) regime — needed by most nationalities, with a long exemption list and further waivers for holders of US/CA/AU/NZ visas. Conditional on holdings; needs the destination visa-policy page, not in the captured set.

United States (US): C-1 transit visa regime — needed by most nationalities except Visa Waiver Program citizens and existing US visa holders. Conditional on holdings; needs the destination visa-policy page, not in the captured set.

Schengen Area: airport-transit-visa (ATV) list — a specific set of nationalities needs an ATV even airside; the rest may transit airside without one. Destination-level rule; needs a clean citable list before encoding per-corridor.
China (CN): 24/48-hour transit-visa-free scheme for holders of specific third-country visas — conditional on holdings.
